camera.perspective: level-looking camera facing a cliff across a beach; foreground water y>600, beach y~500-605 recedes upward; horizon hidden behind cliff (would be above y~250). Principal point assumed (480,480). Focal length unknown - estimate from depth_info + known size.

person.distinguish: only person; on the beach near image centre, walks from x~560 to x~520 (to image left) and slightly toward the camera (feet y 581->592)
person.reference_point: pelvis estimate = 0.53*mask height above lowest mask pixel; x = mean of mask in that row band
person.notes: walks the whole clip, no stop; gait legs cross so width varies 11-18 px; ground shadow to the right and a reflection blob below feet excluded

bird.distinguish: only flying animal; dark silhouette in front of the cliff, flies left->right at y~355-410
bird.notes: wing shape changes every frame so centroid jitters ~2-4 px vs body; exits right edge: touches x=959 from frame 63, last seen frame 66, gone from frame 67

cliff.desc: large sandstone cliff spanning full width behind beach
cliff.top_y_px: about 250 (left) to 290 (right); small plateau block at x 0-137, y 228-248
cliff.base_y_px: about 500 at x 0-470; behind sand slope on right

beach.desc: flat pale sand between cliff and water
beach.notes: water edge y~575 at left, ~600-605 under the person

right_rock.desc: white rounded rock/dune at right edge

water.desc: rippling sea in foreground (texture animates, not an object)

columns_at_cliff_base.desc: vertical stripe pattern at the cliff foot

events.what: clip start: person already walking, bird already flying
